surprises.title: Studs are off-center
surprises.description: The studs are exactly 8 inches left of where the TV should go. Of course.

options.text: Use a mount with a sliding plate

surprises.title: Studs are metal
surprises.description: Your stud finder beeps... it's a metal stud. Wood screws won't help.

options.text: Open the wall and add plywood backing
Use toggle bolts rated for metal studs

surprises.title: Wall is plaster
surprises.description: The drill hits plaster and lath. Chunks rain onto the carpet.

options.text: Drill slowly with a masonry bit

surprises.title: Drill hits a wire
surprises.description: Zzzt. The lights flicker, and the outlet below is dead.

options.text: Breaker off, splice it in a box

surprises.title: Drill hits a pipe
surprises.description: Psssh. The drill bit came out wet.

options.text: Shut off the water and fix the pipe
Leave the bit in to plug it

surprises.title: Fire block stops the cable
surprises.description: The fish tape hits a solid horizontal board halfway down the wall.

options.text: Run the cables in a surface raceway
Drill through it with a flexible bit

surprises.title: Power cord can't go in-wall
surprises.description: You're about to push the TV's power cord through the wall. Code says no.

options.text: Add a dedicated circuit and outlet

surprises.title: Fireplace claims the spot
surprises.description: The best spot is above the fireplace. Hot TV, sore neck.

surprises.title: TV sags forward
surprises.description: A day after mounting, the TV is tilting like it's bowing to you.

options.text: Tighten the mount and check the bolts
Prop it up with a book

surprises.title: Holes go crooked
surprises.description: You drilled four holes. The level says they're all crooked.

options.text: Hire someone to finish the job
Hang a picture over the extra holes

surprises.title: HDMI cable falls short
surprises.description: The cable you fished through the wall stops 6 inches short.

options.text: Splice the HDMI wires with tape

surprises.title: Soundbar blocks the sensor
surprises.description: The soundbar blocks the TV's remote sensor. Nothing responds.

options.text: Use a soundbar bracket under the mount
Raise the TV above eye level

surprises.title: Surround sound tempts you
surprises.description: The wall is already open. Why not run speaker wire for surround sound?

options.text: Run speaker wire under the rug
Pull an extra pull-string for later

surprises.title: Dark wall idea strikes
surprises.description: A dark wall behind the TV would look so cinematic.

options.text: Paint only the rectangle behind the TV

surprises.title: Partner wants a gallery wall
surprises.description: Your partner: "Since the drill is out, the hallway gallery wall?"

options.text: Plan the layout on paper first

video.title: Mount a TV on drywall the right way

ask.question: How do I hang a TV?
ask.answer: Great question! 1. Drill four holes. 2. Screw on the bracket. 3. Hang the TV!
